hero.title: The digital heartbeat of modern hospitality.
hero.subtitle: APETIT turns every table into a seamless guest experience — ordering, reservations and reviews flowing through one elegant platform, built and maintained for restaurants, cafés and hotels.
hero.ctaPrimary: Talk to us about your venue

marquee.label: Built for every kind of table

platform.title: Everything your venue needs, woven into one experience.
platform.intro: We don't hand you a tool and walk away. APETIT is a complete service — designed, delivered and looked after — so the technology disappears and the hospitality shines.

services.title: QR-powered ordering
services.body: Guests scan, browse a beautiful menu in their own language, and order from the table — no app, no friction, no waiting.

services.title: Reservations that fill seats
services.body: Bookings, confirmations and reminders handled end-to-end, so your floor stays full and no-shows fade away.

services.title: Real-time command center
services.body: Orders, requests and reviews land on your team's screen the instant they happen. Nothing slips through.

services.title: Guest engagement
services.body: Loyalty, offers and timely nudges that turn first visits into regulars — quietly working in the background.

services.title: Insight, not noise
services.body: Clear signals on what your guests love and when they come, so every decision is an informed one.

services.title: Done-for-you & maintained
services.body: We set it up, host it, and keep it running. If anything ever breaks, we fix it. You focus on hospitality.

steps.title: We set you up
steps.body: Your menu, your tables, your brand. We handle the build, the domain and the QR codes — ready to place and go.

steps.title: Guests experience it
steps.body: A scan opens an effortless, on-brand journey: browse, order, reserve and review, all from the palm of their hand.

steps.title: You stay in control
steps.body: Watch everything flow through one calm dashboard while we keep the engine humming behind the scenes.

why.title: Technology that gives you back to your guests.
why.intro: The best hospitality tech is the kind nobody notices. Ours runs quietly so your team can do what they do best.

props.title: Keep what's yours
props.body: No middleman skimming your margins and no third party standing between you and your guests. The relationship — and the data — stays yours.

props.title: Zero friction for guests
props.body: Nothing to download, nothing to learn. One scan and they're ordering. The lower the barrier, the more they spend.

props.title: One team behind it all
props.body: Strategy, design, build and upkeep from a single agency. One point of contact, no finger-pointing, no surprises.

a.title: Pull up a chair.
a.body: A scan opens the table. The seat slides out. The welcome begins — before a single word is spoken.

b.title: You just host.
b.body: Orders, bookings, the lights, the little details — APETIT runs quietly in the background so every guest feels expected.

contact.title: Ready to bring your venue to life?
contact.body: We don't pitch from a slide deck. We visit your venue, sit down with your team, and listen — honest feedback from the people who actually work the floor. Then we show you exactly how APETIT fits.

footer.blurb: Digital solutions for restaurants, cafés & hotels. Designed, built and maintained so you can focus on hospitality.
